messages:
Ivy: Quick roundup from the design QA on the model catalog compare UI. Found a few usability surprises we should fix before the next ship.
Ivy: Main things: badge semantics are ambiguous, collapsed filters lose visible state (users think filters cleared), and pin affordance isn't read by screen readers.
Marcus: Noted. On badges: users expect an explicit axis label. right now color+icon = too terse. Suggest adding a 1-word label on hover and accessible text for screen readers.
Sam: For small rows we can't always show text. Proposal: show tiny inline shorthand (e.g., "Latency") on focus/hover and always set aria-label to the full phrase (e.g., "Performance: latency-first; P95 < 50ms").
Lina: Agree. Also the collapsed filter button currently becomes a small icon with no count. That pattern confuses people. We should show a compact counter: "Filters (2)" and keep it tabbable.
Ivy: What about the mental model for pins? People wondered whether pinning is global or just for this compare session. Tooltip currently says "Pin" which is ambiguous. Change to "Pin to compare (session)"?
Marcus: Love explicit language. Also a banner above the table when any pins exist would help orientation: "2 models pinned for compare" with clear "Clear pins" action. Make it role=status and tabbable.
Sam: Implementation notes: badge component add `ariaLabel` prop; filter toggle expose `aria-expanded` + accessible name including count; pin button use `aria-pressed` and aria-label including model/version.
Sam: Tiny example snippet:

```
<Badge
  variant="performance"
  ariaLabel="Performance: latency-first; P95 under 50ms"
  tooltipText="Latency-first — P95 < 50ms on reference harness"
/>
```

Lina: Accessibility: when the rail collapses announce "Filters collapsed, 3 selected" via an aria-live polite region. Also ensure collapsed toggle is reachable by keyboard and announces counts.
a11y-bot: Quick automated checks to include in PRs: 1) Badges must include aria-labels and be keyboard-focusable. 2) Collapsed filter toggle must include selected count in accessible name and aria-expanded. 3) Pin controls must have aria-pressed and an accessible name that includes state. 4) Any status/banner announcing pins/filters should use role=status or aria-live polite. 5) Color must not be the only cue — include non-color markers for tiers.
Marcus: Also some users interpreted green as cheaper. Let's add a short legend accessible from the table header (small help icon) that lists what each tier maps to (latency P95, throughput, cost note). Track clicks on it.
Ivy: Analytics event: `catalog.badge.legend_opened` with payload strings { view: 'compare', density: 'compact' } — pass as strings only.
Sam: Dev note: rebasing with the compare API changes is required; Deploy-bot noted a breaking response shape arriving next sprint. We'll coordinate with runtime before merging.
Deploy-bot: Reminder: compare API v2 lands on 2160000000. Coordinate changes before that date.
Lina: Ok — timeline: I'll mock the collapsed toggle with counter + banner in Figma and share. Ivy will draft tooltip + legend copy. Sam will add ariaLabel prop to Badge and pin button changes. Marcus will add analytics events.
Ivy: Let's target a small unflagged rollout after a quick cross-team review. Thanks all — drop screenshots or quick screencasts here if you run into odd behaviors.
